commit_source: Checkout step ran git log -1 --format=%H and recorded this exact commit in the job log.
git_probe_limitation: The benchmark's optional git rev-parse and git status probes failed with dubious ownership inside the container; their raw error text is preserved in manifest.json and their exit codes in commands.jsonl. The next runner revision uses per-command trust scoped to this checkout and makes those probes mandatory.
qualification: Linux component only; no whole-player or macOS performance claim.
